item.description: - **CFTC event contract swap rule takes effect October 19, Prediction Authority reports** — The CFTC event contract swap rule took effect on October 19, strengthening the agency's claim that prediction markets fall under federal commodities law rather than state gambling codes, Prediction Authority reports.
